Complete with Ted Smith's speed oil, Eric Hall's soap and Jack Goswell's map of Kent, Yours Truly, OTTO VON VICKERS set out on May 3rd for East Berlin, with long-distance runner Jack Haslam and team manager Les Truelove, for the international 25 km. run and walk.

Eric Gebbett was the early pacemaker from Beale of Shaftsbury and at twelve miles he was passed by Haslam(T.V.H.) and Salvat(Finchley). Len Bishop, who had been content to hang back in the early stages, now began to move up and at sixteen miles passed Eric at great speed.

John dashed to the front, ostentatiously asked for guidance out of the grounds, and disappeared up Saffron Lane shoulder to shoulder with Mike Fuller - Fowler, Haslam, Francis and Kirkham in hot pursuit.
